verdict.reasons: Core defect: The text on the packaging in the candidate image is completely illegible gibberish ('Drip Dripaldoo Teio' etc.) and does not match the reference 'Drip Irrigation Tape'. While the main 'AFP' logo and blue water drop are readable, the secondary text is clearly an AI-generation artifact/fake text. According to the instructions, clearly invented or altered branding is a core defect, and the main package identity (text included) must be authentic and readable. Secondary fine print blur is advisory, but this is not merely blur; it is nonsense. This results in a hard reject (fake_text_or_logo=true). Additionally, the white strip coming out of the drip tape looks slightly unnatural but is advisory. Score is 55.
